records.text: Dan Flood did not conduct a walkthrough before Charlie Kirk's event and cared only about ensuring a clean exit behind Kirk.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep 1mYNOqzAdXs)

appearances.snippet: And then after he failed to protect Charlie (Charlie Kirk), didn't even, as I am told from our sources, did not even do a walkthrough. All he cared about in the lead up to that was ensuring that they had a clean exit behind Charlie (Charlie Kirk).

verification.notes: Brian Harpole publicly described Dan Flood only job at the event as Exville, which supports the clean-exit portion. The episode attributes the no-walkthrough claim to internal sources, but current searches found no reliable record confirming that Flood personally skipped a walkthrough. One component is supported and the other remains unverified.

sources.title: Transcript of Charlie Kirk security chief Brian Harpole interview
sources.relevance: Harpole says Dan Flood only job was Exville, supporting the clean-exit component.

sources.title: Secret Service Admits There Was No Threat. ATF Releases Report. | Candace Ep 326
